req.title: Login required for update
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /<id>/update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to access the update endpoint. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can update posts, maintaining security and data integrity. The test suite will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive validation of this requirement.

tests.name: test_redirect_anonymous_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_access_update_authenticated_user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_redirect_boundary_case
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
